notes: Overview: Mid-market product org building outbound SDR chat agents that must perform complex tool-calls (CRM update, send email, schedule via Calendar) and feel real-time to reps. Current stack: internal CRM (SalesForce), GSuite mail/calendar, custom analytics. Evaluating Hosted API for fast time-to-value, but wants pricing differential and SLA for Dedicated if volume grows. POC summary: ran 2-week POC on Hosted API. Positive: tool calling hooks worked with prototype connector; streaming enabled with chunked responses. Measured median token-to-token latency ~65-95ms during low-to-medium load; 95th pct spiked to ~240ms under synthetic concurrency. Target: perceived agent latency <150ms end-to-end and streaming token latency ideally <100ms (VP Product: "sub-100ms streaming makes the agent feel native"). Requirements: must support function/tool calling with idempotency and audit trail, SSO/SAML for enterprise seats, audit logs retained 1 year, EU residency for EU customers, KMS-managed keys. Ops questions: autoscaling behavior under spike, graceful fallback to smaller model variants, prefix/KV cache for repeated prompts. Pricing discussion: team wants two options -- cheaper hosted tier with burst-to-dedicated option, and a reserved Dedicated pool quote for 24/7 peak-facing teams. Blockers: legal wants explicit EU data residency guarantee and audit of connectors; engineering wants better streaming latency numbers at 50-200 concurrent agents; finance needs ARR estimate for Dedicated lanes. Next steps: capture final POC metrics (Jordan), deliver Dedicated pricing sheet (Maya), schedule security deep-dive with Security Solutions (requested doc list in drive). Misc: prospect asked about replayable transcripts and redaction APIs; noted wanting role-based tool call controls (restrict who can send emails). Contact preference: email threads then short syncs. Notes style: bullets + shorthand preserved from call transcripts.
